title: Flag submission (CRITICAL)
inline_answer: Submit every `local.txt` / `proof.txt` value to the **engagement tracker** as you get it. A flag that is in your report but **not** submitted to the panel = **no credit** for it. Submit immediately on capture; do not batch it for the end.

title: Screenshot rules
inline_answer: One screenshot per flag, **one image**, containing all of: an interactive shell (not a web shell), `whoami`, `hostname`, `ip a` / `ipconfig`, and the flag read with `cat`/`type` **from its original path**. If any element is missing or it's a web shell, the flag may be rejected. Capture at the moment you get the shell — don't promise to redo it later.
